paite: Leitung luah tengteng aw, Pathian pahtawi in nuam in kikou unla.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding. Phatna La / Israel Tung A Pathian Hoihna Phatna

paite: Amin thupidan la in sa unla, aphatna hih thupi un.
Pathian kiang ah, "Na thilhihte mulkimhuai na e! Na thilhihtheihna thupidan thu ah nangmah melmate na kiang ah akipelut ding uhi.
Leitung luah tengteng in ahon be ding ua, nangmah phat in la asa ding uh, chi un. Selah
Kisa un, Pathian thilhihte en un; mihing tate tung a athilhih ah akihtakhuai ahi.
Ama'n tuipi leigaw asuaksak a; luipi khe in apaikai ua, huai ah amah ah i kipak uhi.
Athilhihtheihna in tangtawn in vai ahawm hi; amit in namte a-en hi, helhatte kipahtawi kei uhen. Selah
Michihte aw, i Pathian uh phat unla, amah phatna husa theisak un.
Ama'n i hinna uh ahihhing gige a, I khete kisuan aphal kei hi.
Pathian aw, nang na hon enchian a; dangkasik etchet bang in na hon enchian hi.
Nang len ah na hon pilut a; ka kawng uah puakgik giktak na hon koih hi.
Mihingte, kangtalai tung a tuang in, ka lutung uah na paisak a; meikuang leh tui ah ka paisuak ua; himahleh mun hausatak ah lut ding in na hon pikhia ahi.
Halmang thillatte toh na inn ah ka lut ding a, ka thuchiamte na lak ah ka tangtungsak ding hi.
Ka muk in agen a, mangbang a ka om lai a kam in agente mah.
Sathautak halmang thillatte na kiang ah ka lan ding a, belampate hal namtui toh; bawngtalte, kelte toh ka lan ding hi. Selah
Kisa un, Pathian laudan siam tengteng aw, ngaikhia un. Huchi in ka hinna a ding a athilhih ka hon theisak ding hi.
Ka kam in amah ka sam a, ka lei a pahtawi in a-om hi.
Ka lungtang a thulim lou ka limsakleh Toupa'n hon ngaikhe kei ding hi.
Himahleh, Pathian in hon ngaikhia a; ka thumna alimsak hi.
Pathian aw, ka thumna vuaksuaksak lou a, ka lak a azahngaihna tawp sam lou phat in om hen.
